objective: Integrate the authorized private code-based proof into DeFMI canonical confidential settlement while preserving the existing deployment and classical path.
bottleneck: The successful financial smoke is not bound to authoritative DeFMI balances, and its public proof exceeds the existing one-MiB transaction limit.
whole_candidate: A research-gated DeFMI confidential four-account DvP book with code-based before/after state commitments; one native seven-party threshold-two MPC proof of 64-bit balances, quantity, price, product and atomic conservation; canonical chunk transport under unchanged transaction/block limits; immutable deployment policy, authorization, replay rejection and persisted-state recovery.
likely_prediction_error: The partitioned masked linear relation or canonical large-proof transport fails before a valid persisted settlement.
population: Fresh isolated DeFMI state and distributed private book issuance, one private delivery-versus-payment transition and no-fill conservation transition, with the actual native engine and public proof artifacts. Existing legacy tests remain regression gates, not substitutes.
negative_gates: altered or incomplete canonical proof chunks
invalid private product or negative balance
rejection_rule: A financial transition without a verified relation to the authoritative previous commitment, a missing real native run, a substituted classical proof, a weakened bound, or any accepted negative prevents completion.
promotion_rule: At most smoke_only for the isolated integration. Security/composition and concrete PQ parameter review, independent operators and full venue-specific QOMM/OCLOB adapters remain separate gates; no production claim or public deployment is authorized.
preflight: An integration runner must bind these exact contract bytes to a closed manifest and atomically claim a fresh output before executing the whole native-to-DeFMI path.
postflight: Write public proof, native and canonical transition receipts, source and dependency identities, and append one verdict without private inputs or shares.
